spinner: Nothing loops in this theme, so the busy sign is three 2px-framed blocks, two black and the last in the signal yellow, set down once and left standing.
skeleton: Each line is a 2px black frame with a 45 degree hatch, the form's mark for 'not yet', wiped in once from the left with no pulse and no grey.
switch: A nearly square slot with a 2px black frame; on, it fills signal yellow and the white block goes solid black in one short move.
check: A 2px black box that fills the signal with a heavy black tick wiped in; the chosen radio is a black dot inside a yellow ring, never a box.
toast: A 2px frame with a thick black rule down its leading edge, wiped onto the page from that edge: no float and no fade.
dialog: The register's 3px frame and a 3px rule under the title, wiped in from the top like a sheet put in front of you.
tooltip: The one inverted surface: bold white words on black with a black pointer, appearing whole after the delay instead of fading.
steps: Square markers joined by 2px rules; done ones solid black, the current one a signal-yellow block with its name bold and underlined.
empty: A solid 2px frame with a heavy rule across the top, a large bold title and a body in full black: no dashed edge, no grey.
link: Always underlined at 2px; under the pointer the signal yellow lands behind the words and the underline thickens to 3px.
